title: Coarse-to-fine standard 3DGS with late densification in one optimizer lifecycle
question: Does a cheap low-resolution fixed-topology phase prepare the initialization well enough that full-resolution densification starting later reaches equal held-out quality with materially fewer total rendered pixels and less wall time?
hypothesis: A schedule spending its first 20% at render/loss downscale 2, SH degree 0, and fixed topology, then enabling masks, densification, and progressive SH at full resolution inside the same optimizer lifecycle, reaches the target held-out PSNR with fewer total rendered pixels and no final-quality loss versus the current full-resolution-from-step-0 default; the coarse phase, not merely the delayed density start, carries the saving.
claim_boundary: Development evidence for the resolution/topology curriculum inside the standard RGB trainer on the two development-exposed stage frames. The delayed-density full-resolution control isolates the coarse phase's contribution from the later density start. It establishes no cross-scene generality, no compact/VRAM claim, no MCMC-strategy applicability, and no production default change; low-resolution screen-gradient statistics must never drive full-resolution topology decisions, and any violation invalidates the run.

stages.label: Load matched initialization
stages.purpose: Load one shared frozen 3D initialization and verify its hash, count, and parameters so only the schedule differs between cells.

stages.label: Load train RGB/masks
stages.purpose: Load only the frozen training cameras with calibrated undistortion and lossless masks.

stages.label: Coarse fixed-topology phase
stages.purpose: Treatment cells only: render/loss downscale 2, SH degree 0, densification disabled, optimizing means, scales, opacities, and DC color inside the same optimizer lifecycle so Adam state survives the transition.

stages.label: Full-resolution densification phase
stages.purpose: Full resolution with masks enabled and step-conditional densification active; screen-gradient accumulators are reset at the resolution transition so no low-resolution statistic drives a full-resolution topology decision; SH degree advances 0 to 1.

stages.label: Final refinement phase
stages.purpose: Ordinary density schedule tail at full resolution with SH degree advancing 1 to 3 under the shared budget.

stages.label: Held-out RGB evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate every cell on identical held-out cameras at matched total iterations and at the matched wall-clock checkpoint.

comparators.label: Full-resolution default schedule
comparators.purpose: The current full-resolution-from-step-0 recipe with the ordinary density schedule; the status-quo anchor.

comparators.label: Coarse phase then late densification
comparators.purpose: 0-20% downscale-2/SH0/fixed topology, 20-60% full resolution with masks, densification, SH 0 to 1, 60-100% ordinary density tail with SH 1 to 3; the treatment.

comparators.label: Delayed densification at full resolution
comparators.purpose: Full resolution throughout with the same delayed density start; isolates the coarse phase's rendered-pixel saving from the density-start delay.

primary_metrics.label: Total rendered pixels
primary_metrics.aggregation: sum of H_k x W_k over all training renders per run; median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Training wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Wall time to target held-out PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over seeds and scenes at the frozen target

primary_metrics.label: Held-out PSNR immediately before the first density event
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Topology events and growth trajectory
primary_metrics.aggregation: count of clone/split/prune events and count trajectory per run; median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Child survival fraction
primary_metrics.aggregation: fraction of clone/split children alive 500 iterations after birth; median over events, seeds, and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR at matched iterations
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR at the matched wall-clock checkpoint
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out SSIM at matched iterations
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

resource_protocol.scope: fresh image-supervised training process from calibrated train-image open through final PLY save; heldout evaluation is timed and reported separately; rendered-pixel accounting is recorded per phase
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median on one idle named GPU; retain every raw repeat and report min/max

blockers: Replace the blanket rejection of non-unit TrainStepControl combined with densify with step-conditional density gating (density enabled only when the current step's render and loss downscales are 1 and the step has reached the frozen density start) behind a config whose default preserves the current rejection, with CPU-first tests for the gating truth table and the masked-training interaction.
Reset screen-gradient and count accumulators at the resolution transition and add a test proving no low-resolution grad2d statistic influences a full-resolution topology decision.

Freeze the phase fractions (0.20/0.60), SH-degree schedule mapping, density start, total iterations, target PSNR, matched wall-clock checkpoint, shared initialization artifact and hash, and the exact argv command before setting status to ready.
Freeze the CUDA host, GPU identity, and idle policy; this protocol cannot run on the CPU-only reference path.
Assign a frozen owner and obtain a distinct outcome-unseen prospective protocol review.
